_note: v2 hooks for le Passage de la Brocante (ST_brocante, S03_market), an autumn flea-market passage full of falling golden leaves and bric-a-brac, the share-store-money street (ST_commerce seg005-008). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; beret color = verb group.

fr_negocier_verb.why: NEGOTIATE → négocier = to negotiate (négocier le prix). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (nay-go-SYAY -> nay-goh-SYAY).
